purpose: Product Design ideation for the existing star map, grounded Ask and pending Wiki candidates

displayedOptions.name: 星图伴随问答
displayedOptions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one realistic, production-quality desktop application UI design, 1440 x 1024, with clear hierarchy, readable typography and purposeful spacing. This is a design proposal for the existing Chinese product 联读研究台. The three attached images are reference screenshots: the current question-focused star map, the current constellation overview, and the current evolution reader. They are style and product-context references, not images to copy literally. Preserve their near-black/navy surfaces, compact left navigation, violet accent, quiet purple/blue/cyan star clusters, and restrained glow. Do not invent a new brand or green primary theme.
The user goal is to ask a question, co-read Wiki pages, verify the actual evidence and continue into a candidate that requires independent review. Keep the star map visibly present throughout this frame; do not replace it with a generic chatbot or admin form.
Design one focused primary screen showing a completed temporary answer and a newly created candidate awaiting review. Show one clear primary action and at most two supporting areas. The graph is a bounded local knowledge view, not the whole database. Use spacing, alignment, typography and simple separators before surface tints, borders or elevation. Avoid nested cards and feature-inventory dashboards. Main text 14-16px, prominent question 24-28px, comfortable line length. Use clean Chinese UI typography akin to the references. Keep copy concise and exactly readable. No browser chrome or device frame. No decorative metrics, fake activity feeds or excessive gradients.
Shared illustrative scenario, clearly marked 设计示例: current question 如何兼顾叙事吸引与商品辨认？ Existing Wiki A 结果可辨认, B 特征可靠呈现, C1 信息职责与镜头手段, and counterexample D 故事被记住，商品没认出. A draft C2 is titled 先辨认，再叙事 and must be explicitly marked 待审候选 · 未发表. A small document-shaped source is 拉片报告, marked 原文未回查. The temporary answer says 先明确商品信息，再选择叙事与镜头。现有依据仍缺直接识别测试。 Candidate adds the condition 关键外观特征需在故事开始前可辨认。
Semantic constraints: preserve existing star-group colors. User selection is a thin white outline with A/B labels. Actual reads use a small explicit 已读 tag, not a truth/confidence glow. Show 本轮读入 3 页 and 已选 2 页 as clear compact context, not KPI cards. Amber is reserved for challenge D. Candidate C2 uses a lilac or white dashed outline in a separate preview overlay with an unmistakable 待审 tag; never render it as already published or on a formal publication timeline. Ordinary navigation lines stay faint. Only explicit existing support/challenge relationships may have those labels; candidate input connections are dotted and labeled 研究输入 or 候选预览. Do not draw a supposed chronological model-traversal path: the service has an actual readset, not a full reasoning replay. A quiet legend can say 已读仅代表读取 · 候选尚未发表. Exact IDs, digests and raw operation keys belong behind details, not in the main UI. Do not add a 2.5D experiment switch.
Current date anchor is 2026-11-02; this screen does not need dates. This is synthetic design content, not real business evidence. One independent full screen, no collage, no numbered option label, no presentation title outside the UI.

Direction name: 星图伴随问答.
Composition: keep the familiar compact 64px navigation rail, a slim 170px research context column, a broad central 3D-style star map, and a 370px right-hand reading notebook. Top full-width header 联读研究台 and a subtle 设计示例 badge. The main question sits at the top of the work area. Preserve 星群 / 问题 / 演化, with 问题 active, and 2D / 3D / 列表 with 3D active.
The central map occupies about 60 percent of the working width and most of the height. Show a modest local constellation with 15-25 small quiet nodes and four clearly labelled focus nodes A, B, C1, D. The selected C1 stays visually central. A and B have small 已读 tags and visible A/B selection markers. D has a restrained amber challenge connector. Keep decorative graph density low enough to read.
The right notebook is a continuous readable column, not a stack of nested cards. It has title 本次回答, the concise answer with small inline [A] [B] citations, a short boundary heading 仍需核对 with 直接商品识别测试, and a subtle section 继续研究的结果 with candidate C2 title and its added condition. The single prominent action is 打开待审候选. Below it is a quiet 返回问题与选择 link. Source preview belongs in a small lower-right row 拉片报告 · 原文未回查. IDs hidden.
Candidate C2 is a small dashed-lilac preview callout near the map's lower edge, labelled 候选预览 and 待审, connected only by a dotted 研究输入 line. It must not compete visually with the current published C1. Bottom graph footer uses the shared semantic legend and 当前范围. The actual-read display, selection and pending state are visibly different mechanisms. End result should feel like a thoughtful improvement to the provided working product, not a sci-fi illustration.

Direction name: 答案为主的联读画布.
Create a meaningfully different layout from a graph-centric notebook. Use only the compact 64px navigation rail, no broad left context sidebar. A full-width header contains 联读研究台, 设计示例, and the current question. Below it, divide the main work area into a generous 730px reading canvas on the LEFT and an always-visible 600px star map on the RIGHT. About 55 percent of the useful area is reading, 45 percent graph. No stacked full-page forms. The reading canvas should feel like a thoughtful research document with generous line length and paragraph rhythm.
At the top of the left reading canvas show 本次回答 and a small 临时结论 label. Show a substantial, legible answer headline 先明确商品信息，再选择叙事与镜头。 Then two short numbered claims with inline citation chips [A] and [B], and a short section 适用条件 with one bullet 关键外观特征应清楚、稳定地呈现。 A counterexample quote marked [D] says 故事被记住，商品没认出；under it say 仍需直接商品识别测试. Do not make D look like a fourth actually read page; D is an existing related challenge shown for subsequent reading. Include a concise 读集 row explicitly 本轮读入：A、B、C1 and a separate 已选：A、B. C1 must also have an 已读 tag on the graph. Do NOT invent other report titles, books or handbooks.
Below a simple separator, a small open research continuation area says 新候选已形成 and shows C2 先辨认，再叙事 with 待审候选 · 未发表 and the concise added condition. One prominent purple action 打开待审候选. A secondary exact source row 拉片报告 · 原文未回查 appears below it, outside the actual-read set.
The RIGHT graph is always present at useful size, with about 12-20 subdued local nodes and clearly spaced A, B, C1, D labels. Show existing 3D view active, with compact 2D / 3D / 列表 controls, and 星群 / 问题 / 演化 context. A is selected from an inline citation, expressed by a thin white outline; A, B, C1 each have a separate 已读 tag. C1 remains published current knowledge; C2 is a separate small dashed-lilac preview annotation at the map's lower margin, marked 待审 rather than a published star. The graph header says 与当前问题有关的认识. Below the graph, a shallow citation detail strip (not a nested card) says 正在核对 A：结果可辨认 with a short excerpt 商品应在画面中可被识别与区分 and a quiet 阅读完整 Wiki link. This strip makes the reading-to-graph relationship understandable without invented model reasoning paths.
Precise legend: 当前选择 uses a hollow white ring; 本轮已读 uses a small explicit label; 挑战 uses an amber dashed line; 候选 uses a separate dashed-lilac rectangle. Never combine 已读 and 已选 into one meaning or one legend item. Do not use arrows or connection glow to imply that actual reading proves support.
Keep the visual character grounded in the screenshots, with restrained existing star-map depth rather than a flattened cartoon network. The page is a Chinese research workspace, not a chat conversation with bubbles.

Direction name: 星图中的版本核对.
This screen focuses on inspecting a pending change in the context of existing knowledge, unlike a reading-first answer page. Preserve the compact 64px left rail and top 联读研究台 header with 设计示例. The current question 如何兼顾叙事吸引与商品辨认？ stays visible across the full workspace, with a small 返回原问答 link. The center-left 850px is a broad quiet 3D star map, and the right 450px is a clean continuous change-inspection column. Use only spacing, section headings and fine separators inside that column, avoiding a pile of nested cards.
The central map shows published C1 信息职责与镜头手段 as the primary filled violet star, connected with explicit existing support relationships from A 结果可辨认 and B 特征可靠呈现. D 故事被记住，商品没认出 is a separate amber challenge to C1, labelled 相关挑战 · 本轮未读. Actual reads A, B, C1 each have a discrete 已读 tag; current selected A/B is separately marked with white outline selection tags. Never show D as an answer citation. Use 15-20 quiet background stars; map remains legible.
To the lower right of C1, add a separate clearly bounded rectangular dashed-lilac overlay labelled 候选预览：C2. Within it place a document-shaped glyph, the title 先辨认，再叙事 and 待审候选 · 未发表. It is NOT a glowing formal star. One dashed connector from C1 is labelled 比较预览. Short dotted input hints from the actual-read group may be labelled 编纂输入, never 已证实 or 支持. Do not include a publication date or publish C2 on an evolution timeline. Keep 星群 / 问题 / 演化 controls and 2D / 3D / 列表, with 问题 and 3D active.
Right column heading 这次准备改变什么？ followed by small 当前版 C1 → 待审候选 C2. Three clear comparison sections:
保留的认识 — 分开选择信息职责与镜头手段。
候选新增的条件 — 关键外观特征需在故事开始前可辨认。
仍需核对 — 现有依据缺直接商品识别测试。
Then a concise line 正式知识仍为 C1，C2 等待独立审阅。 One clear purple primary action 打开待审候选, not approve/publish. Quiet secondary 阅读完整差异 link.
At the bottom of the map, a shallow anchored research-context strip, no more than 160px tall, shows 来自本次问答, a one-line temporary answer 先明确商品信息，再选择叙事与镜头。, and separate plain-text rows 本轮读入：A、B、C1 and 用户选择：A、B. A small source row 拉片报告 · 原文未回查 is explicitly outside the readset. Do not invent books, handbooks or other source titles. This bottom strip retains the answer while most of the space explains the pending change.
Graph legend must separately encode 当前选择, 本轮已读, 挑战 and 候选预览. 已读 is a label, not all purple nodes; candidate is a dashed rectangle, not a solid star. Keep the original dark restrained product language, clear text, ample spacing and a realistic implementable UI. No generic dashboard counters or imagined model reasoning trace.

userRefinement: drag divider to resize reading and graph; allow larger graph view

refinement.status: user-selected option 2 plus explicit resize refinement
refinement.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup edit. The attached image is the user's SELECTED design for 联读研究台: reading on the left and a persistent live star map on the right. Refine this same design; do not invent a new direction. Target desktop 1440x1024, preserve the attached image's natural aspect ratio, dark navy/violet visual language, readable Chinese typography, core hierarchy, graph rendering, compact navigation and question.
User's explicit refinement: users must be able to drag the boundary to resize the two panes, and use a larger star-map view when needed. Add a clearly discoverable but restrained vertical draggable divider between the reading pane and graph pane, with a small neutral grip at mid-height and subtle focus/hover treatment. A small nearby tooltip says 拖动调整宽度 · 双击复位. Add a quiet 放大星图 action in the graph toolbar, reusing its existing expand affordance. Keep both panes visibly open in this frame at roughly 52% reading / 48% graph. Do not make multiple states or a collage. Layout ratios can change at runtime; show one coherent default state.
Correct three semantic details while preserving the layout: select 问题 rather than 星群; show A, B, C1 as the exact 本轮读入 set with separate 已选 A、B; move the unread challenge D out of the temporary answer's direct citations into a clearly labeled 待联读的相关挑战 row with 本轮未读. The 未回查 拉片报告 stays outside the actual readset. Actual-read marks are explicit 已读 text tags, not a legend that implies every purple star is read.
Keep the candidate C2 summary in the reading area with one primary 打开待审候选 action. On the graph, C2 should be a clearly separate dashed-lilac rectangular preview, with document icon and 待审候选 · 未发表, rather than an ordinary published glowing star. Candidate connections are input/preview hints, never asserted support. Retain exact existing data titles and concise copy; do not invent additional assets or facts. Preserve editable UI text as realistic UI; no device/browser frame, no added 2.5D feature. Mark 设计示例. Current date anchor: 2026-11-02, no visible dates needed.
